_comment: Hand-written CV material with no source of truth elsewhere: employment,
education, community service, skills, bibliometrics, and the pre-website
supervision. Read directly by cv/cv.typ, and by Hugo as hugo.Data.cv.* —
`employment` and `education` are what /experience/ renders, so an edit here
reaches the PDF and the website at once. Everything the website already
knows — publications, grants, theses, courses, projects — is pulled from its
own source of truth by tools/build-cv.py and must NOT be duplicated here.
Entries share one shape: title, date, location and description (prose).
`location` is where the work happened, institute first — it is the line the
pin icon introduces on both the CV and /experience/. `funder` is optional
and stated only when somebody other than that institute paid; it gets the
money icon. Other sections still use neat-cv's `institution` field.
An education entry may add `output`: the citation key of the dissertation it
